product.title: Cortech The Rock Flexible Insulated Food Tray
product.body_html:
Cortech Rock Flexible Trays with Cor-Flex have a 2 year manufacturers warranty. You can fit 132 trays in the Chuckwagon, 80 trays in the Chuckwagon Jr., and 156 trays in the Tray Master. The Cortech Rock Flexible Food Tray is ideal for use in all correctional facilities, prisons, and jails.

  • The radius corners and softly beveled bottom make it easier to eat from and easier to clean.
  • Made from an insulated material, has no internal insulation, which means it will not absorb water.
  • Constructed of high impact, no break, polypropylene. Made with FDA Approved material and built to ISO Quality Standards in the US.
  • 2 Year Warranty
  • Five insulated food compartments and two condiment compartments, 2.25” deep.
  • Will stack with or without lids (sold separately).
  • Colors: 2000CF Chocolate Brown, 2000DGF Dark Grey, 2000TCF Terra Cotta, and 2000OF Orange.
  • Packed 10 per case, must buy in full cases. Price is per piece

THE ROCK, Cortech's true one-piece seamless design insulated food tray, has been tested in correctional facilities with over 350 different menus. The 5 compartments have proven that they can handle any correctional meal, plus with the 2 additional condiment compartments, use of bulk condiment portions will yield a savings that can pay for the tray itself.

About Cortech USA by Correctional Technologies:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
